main_text.l: ILLUSTRI, MAGNIFICO & generoso Domino, DN. LUDOVICO A SAYN, COMITI IN VVITGENSTEIN ET HOMBURG, &c. SUMMO Palatinæ Electoralis aulæ præfecto, Domino clementi.

ILLUSTRIS & Magnifice Domine, summa animi subiectione colende. Cum multa aliarelí-gionis Christianæ veritatem contra Atheos, Epicureos & profanos evincant: & nobis omnibusque piis egregiè confirment ac commendent: ab aliarum quoq; gentium & sectarum quarumvis ἐξελοθρη[?]σκείαις placitis, cultibusque commentitiis longissimè secernant, & supra falsarum religionum vanitatem adeò extollant, ut tantùm caput efferat illa, quantum lenta solent inter viburna cupressi: tum illud inprimis irrefragabilem eius autoritatem sancit ac luculentissimè demonstrat, quòd ea sola ab unico & vero Deo, humano generi patefa-

page.notes: The first word of the body is printed in capitals with the woodcut initial "I" joined to it; the whole body text is italic except "summa animi subiectione colende", which is roman. The Greek word after "quarumvis" is printed with uncertain letters, marked [?]. Printed spellings such as "quoq;", "tantùm", "quòd" and "euincant" are copied as printed; only u/v was normalised ("euincant" to "evincant", "vnico" to "unico", "ILLVSTRI" to "ILLUSTRI", "SVMMO" to "SUMMO", "HOMBVRG" to "HOMBURG"). "tefa-" is the catchword and is not repeated in the text. The empty footnote element is left in by mistake and should be removed.
